title: Onboarding for Product team Operations group
content:
If Operations Outlook group is created during onboarding after initial members have been added send a short intro mail to group.

Include minimum the PO but preferably the entire team. Include persons from DevOps team as needed.

“

This group will be used as point of contact for operations related communication.

The group has been created by IPEX DevOps team during setup for {team name} product resources.

Product Owner is administrator and can update members in Outlook, {deeplink}

 

More information about Product team operations group is available on IPEX Home.

Best Regards

/ DevOps Team

“
